svg.aria-label: Cuttlefish approval gate: a tool-call request rides a conveyor belt as a stamped card and slides under a phone-shaped approval press. The press holds the card until the lit APPROVE lever is pulled; the DENY lever drops the card down a chute into a reject bin. Approved cards ride on to the workspace drum, where the session lives in a DigitalOcean-hosted microVM. High-risk calls need Face ID first — the little lock dial on the phone screen. The numbers are the ones from the story: 7 harnesses, 20,000+ tools.
svg.text: 7 harnesses · 20,000+ tools · Face ID on high-risk calls
